test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Watershed management emphasizes on:

a. Conservation of water and soil

b. Improve primary sources of land and soil

c. Increase production and income of the watershed community

d. Increasing income only by increasing agriculture and crop yield

Which among the above statements are correct with respect to Watershed management?
solution:
The correct answer is__** a, b and c**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The correct statements with respect to Watershed management are:

 
• **a. Conservation of water and soil:**

 
 
• Watershed management aims to protect and conserve the natural resources within a watershed, including water and soil.
 
• This involves various practices like afforestation, contour farming, and gully control to prevent soil erosion and maintain water quality.
 
 
 
• **Improve primary sources of land and soil** .
 
 
• By addressing issues like soil erosion, land degradation, and pollution, watershed management can enhance the quality and productivity of the land within the watershed.
 
• This, in turn, can contribute to increased agricultural yields and improved livelihoods for the local community.
 
 
 
• **c. Increase production and income of the watershed community:**
 
 
• Watershed management can help improve the livelihoods of people living within the watershed by increasing agricultural productivity, promoting sustainable practices, and diversifying income sources.
 
• There fore a,b and c are correct
